items.title: Yarn PnP package lookup treats browser polyfills as builtins
items.trigger: In a Yarn Plug'n'Play project, resolve installed browser packages named buffer or string_decoder through Vite package metadata lookup.
items.finding: The new PnP resolution path calls resolveToUnqualified without considerBuiltins:false. The default treats names shared with Node builtins as builtin modules and returns no package location instead of resolving the installed browser-polyfill package; Vite then reports missing package metadata. The upstream fix explicitly disables builtin treatment in this package-only lookup.

items.title: Package-name matching ignores explicit SSR external entry
items.trigger: Set ssr.external to ['external-entry/entry'] and ssr.noExternal to ['external-entry']; import the same stateful entry both directly and from another external package.
items.finding: Replacing includes(id) with includes(pkgName) prevents an explicit package subpath from matching ssr.external. The package-level noExternal filter can then bundle that entry despite its explicit external declaration, splitting its module state from the Node-loaded copy. The fix prioritizes an exact id match and adds a state-sharing regression fixture.

items.title: Required shallowReactive brand rejects plain object assignment

No public caller can provide the uninhabitable required brand. The fix replaces it with an optional private-class brand; the added assignment test exercises this exact source compatibility regression.

items.title: Casting exact admin search fields prevents use of ordinary database indexes
items.trigger: Configure a Django admin exact search on an indexed non-text field, such as search_fields = ["id__exact"], and search a large PostgreSQL table.
items.finding: For a non-text field such as an indexed integer id searched via id__exact, the introducing change annotates Cast(field_name, CharField()) and filters the cast alias. On PostgreSQL an ordinary integer/primary-key index cannot serve that cast expression, causing full scans on large tables. The fix removes Cast and validates each search term against its target field before building direct lookups.

`````
Fixes https://code.djangoproject.com/ticket/36865

## Description

This PR fixes a performance regression introduced in PR #17885.

The `Cast` to `CharField` for non-string field exact lookups prevents database index usage on primary key fields, generating SQL like:

```sql
WHERE ("table"."id")::varchar = '123'
```

This cannot use the primary key index and causes full table scans, resulting in timeouts on large tables (reported in [ticket #26001 comment 24](https://code.djangoproject.com/ticket/26001#comment:24)), and discovered in a project I work on at https://github.com/freelawproject/courtlistener/issues/6790.

## Solution

Drop the casting approach introduced in #17885, and replace it with field validation that uses `to_python` on the results of `smart_split` to ensure that we only apply field-term pairs that make sense. For example: 

 - searching a PrimaryKey field for "foo" --> Nope!
 - searching a TextField for "foo" --> Yes!
 - searching a TextField for "123" --> Close enough. Yes!

And so forth. 

This should ensure DB indexes are used and that we don't send nonsensical queries in the first place. 

## Trac tickets

Introducing issue: https://code.djangoproject.com/ticket/26001
Solving it: https://code.djangoproject.com/ticket/36865
`````

items.title: FileWithLineNum reports an inner wrapper after caller extraction
items.trigger: Call FileWithLineNum through an external wrapper chain and compare the reported file:line with the established outer caller location.
items.finding: The introduction routes FileWithLineNum through an additional CallerFrame wrapper while retaining runtime.Callers(3). An external wrapper chain is therefore resolved one frame too early, changing the file:line returned by the established helper. The fix chooses explicit stack skips separately for CallerFrame and FileWithLineNum, and tests the wrapped call chain.

items.title: Composite map key-set removal exposes a hidden duplicate key
items.trigger: Construct a CompositeMap with a key present in both backing maps and call compositeMap.keySet().remove(key).
items.finding: The introduced short-circuit OR skips removing the element from the second collection after the first removal succeeds. CompositeSet inherits this behavior and backs CompositeMap.keySet(); deleting an overlapping key therefore reveals the previously hidden second-map entry instead of removing the mapping. The fix overrides set removal to evaluate removals against both sets.

items.title: Alternative timer reset registers with a different runtime
items.trigger: Enable the unstable alternative timer; create a Sleep under runtime A and reset it while running under runtime B.
items.finding: Timer::new computes its deadline using the original runtime handle, then unconditionally pushes the entry onto the current worker runtime registration queue. Resetting a sleep from another runtime can migrate its timer or panic in a current-thread runtime. The introducing patch removed the runtime identity guard; the fix restores the guard and falls back to registration through the original runtime handle.
